<observations>
Date: Jul 6, 2026
* 🔴 (09:45) User stated reception guest limit is strictly 150 people.
* 🔴 (13:10) User stated floral budget cannot exceed $4,500.
* 🔴 (17:22) User prefers minimalist gold geometric table centerpieces.
* 🟡 (11:05) Cousin Thomas has severe peanut allergies; catering briefed on allergen protocols.
* 🟡 (21:10) RSVP automation rules configured on wedding website.

Date: Jul 9, 2026
* 🔴 (09:15) Finalized wedding hashtag is #ToHaveAndToHolt2026.
* 🔴 (17:50) Photographer arrival set for two hours before ceremony (bridal suite at noon).
* 🟡 (12:10) Acoustic indie Spotify dinner playlist compiled.
* 🟡 (16:35) Checked ADA-compliant coach availability with Metro Luxury Transit.

Date: Jul 12, 2026
* 🔴 (09:10) Seating chart must separate college friends from immediate family tables.
* 🔴 (13:30) Catering final headcount cutoff date is September 1st, 2026.
* 🟡 (12:00) Researched regional artisanal welcome bag snacks (local pretzels and cider).

Date: Jul 15, 2026
* 🔴 (15:20) Venue walkthrough scheduled for August 26, 2026.
* 🟡 (12:05) Ordered leaf-based biodegradable confetti sample packs from EcoCelebrations.

Date: Jul 19, 2026
* 🔴 (12:45) Ring bearer pillow must be handmade from vintage lace.
* 🔴 (16:30) Welcome bags must include local craft beer and artisan chocolate.
* 🟡 (08:15) Floral design brief updated for white rose and eucalyptus arches.
* 🟡 (20:15) Evening timeline adjusted for 45-minute sunset portrait session.

Date: Jul 23, 2026
* 🔴 (09:15) Final rehearsal dinner capped at 35 guests at The Rustic Hearth Restaurant.
* 🔴 (16:45) Cake flavor updated to pistachio (replacing previous lemon raspberry choice).
* 🔴 (17:00) Videographer final payment due August 10, 2026.
* 🔴 (13:10) Ordered 100 personalized ceramic coasters from Kiln & Clay Studio as favors.
* 🟡 (08:20) Morning getting-ready robes updated to pure mulberry silk.
* ✅ (21:00) Gluten-free macaron tower addition confirmed with Sweet Treats Bakery.
</observations>

<suggested-response>
The assistant should wait for the user to provide the next wedding planning task or question.
</suggested-response>
